title: A learned temporal ordering reveals uneven volatility-heredity evidence across time series
summary: The source evaluates ordering quality on finance and fMRI benchmarks and reports uneven pairwise evidence for volatility dependence. The source notes no complete reference ordering for real markets; benchmark ordering does not establish a true universal or causal order.
ai_technology: A temporal convolutional model orders observed series by learned volatility memory, with statistical guidance and comparisons to reference orderings.
